home.title: Next.js + shadcn
home.description: This project now runs with a locale-aware baseline and standardized next-intl loading.

quickStart.title: Quick start
quickStart.step1: Open src/app/[locale]/page.tsx and edit the homepage.
quickStart.step2: Add additional localized strings under src/messages/*.json.
quickStart.step3: Run pnpm dev and open http://localhost:3000/en.
